quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #9
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: A train has passed at a railroad crossing. What should you do?

options.text: Wait for the signal lights to stop flashing.

questions.explanation: Watch for a second train even after the first one passes. Do not drive until all gates are raised and all warning lights stop flashing.

questions.question: Your power steering stops working while driving. What should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn and turn off the engine.
Turn on hazard lights and hold tight.
Steer firmly, slow down, and drive to a safe place to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steer firmly, slow down, and drive to a safe place to stop.
questions.explanation: When power steering fails, steering becomes harder. Slow down and move to a safe area before stopping.

questions.question: The road is wet or icy. What should you do?

options.text: Drive at the posted speed limit.

questions.explanation: Tires do not grip wet, snowy, or icy roads as well as dry roads. Slow down in these conditions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign shows a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should never:

options.text: Change lanes while inside an intersection.
Check your blind spot by looking over your shoulder.
Check for other drivers moving into the same lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes while inside an intersection.
questions.explanation: Never change lanes in an intersection. Always check your blind spot before changing lanes. Watch for other drivers doing the same.

questions.question: Keep extra space between your vehicle and which of these?
questions.explanation: Keep extra distance behind motorcycles. They stop faster than other vehicles. You need room to stop if the rider brakes or falls. Motorcycles are hard to see at night because they have only one tail light.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You can proceed if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass these signs, you are going the wrong way and risk a head-on crash. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What helps someone recover from drinking alcohol?
questions.explanation: Only time will reduce the effects of alcohol.

questions.question: Large vehicles can have blind spots extending up to 200 feet behind them.
questions.explanation: Large vehicles have blind spots up to 200 feet behind them. Do not tailgate these vehicles because the driver cannot see you.

questions.question: Backing up your vehicle is:

options.text: Dangerous only if you have a helper.

questions.explanation: Backing up is always dangerous because you cannot see well behind your vehicle. Be extra careful when backing up.

questions.question: When making a right turn on a green light, you must:

options.text: Keep driving at your normal speed.
Stop and look for police cars.

questions.explanation: You can turn right or left on a green light unless a sign says you cannot. When you turn, you must let other vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection go first.

questions.question: The best way to avoid a dangerous situation while driving is to:

options.text: Watch what is happening around your vehicle.
Keep your eyes on the road ahead only.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch what is happening around your vehicle.
questions.explanation: Always pay attention to everything around your vehicle. Look ahead, to the sides, and behind your car. This helps you spot problems early so you can change your speed or move to a safer position.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the divided highway will end soon.

questions.question: A regulatory sign with a red circle and a line through it means:

options.text: Some drivers must yield to others.
Drive slower than the speed limit.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are rectangular with white backgrounds and red or black markings. A red circle with a line through a black symbol means that action is not allowed.

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic light means a ____ light will come next.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light tells you that a steady red light is coming next.

questions.question: If your tires lose contact with the road surface, you should:

options.text: Shift to a lower gear to slow down.
Pump the brakes quickly and firmly.

questions.explanation: If your tires lose contact with the road, release the gas pedal and do not use the brakes. Wait until your tires grip the road again before you stop or turn.

questions.question: Double solid yellow lines in the center of the road mean passing is:
questions.explanation: Double yellow lines mean no car can cross the center line to pass, no matter which direction you are traveling.

questions.question: Use your headlights on rainy, snowy, or foggy days:

options.text: So other drivers can see your vehicle.
To warn other drivers about bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: So other drivers can see your vehicle.
questions.explanation: In rain, snow, or fog, other drivers have trouble seeing your vehicle. Headlights make your car easier to spot. If you need to use your wipers, you must also turn on your low beam headlights.

questions.question: Work zone signs mean:

options.text: Drive faster to leave the work zone.

questions.explanation: Work zone signs are orange and warn that work is happening on or near the road. Be very careful when you see these signs.

questions.question: Trucks have blind spots:

options.text: Directly to the left of the cab.
Directly to the left of the cab and directly behind the truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: Directly to the left of the cab and directly behind the truck.
questions.explanation: Trucks have much larger blind spots than cars. The driver cannot see vehicles behind them. If you cannot see the driver's face in their mirror, the driver cannot see you.

questions.question: Your blind spot is the area of the road that you cannot see without moving your head.

options.text: You cannot see without moving your head.
You see in your rearview mirror.
You see in your side mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot see without moving your head.
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas around your vehicle that you cannot see without turning your head. They are usually on the sides and behind your car.

questions.question: At dawn, dusk, rain, or snow, it is hard to see and be seen. What should you turn on to let other drivers know you are there?
questions.explanation: Use your headlights when you cannot see other vehicles clearly or when other drivers may have trouble seeing you. Turn on your low beam headlights if you need to use your windshield wipers.

questions.question: Which statement is true about driving on a wet road?

options.text: As you drive faster, your tires become less effective.
Water does not affect cars with good tires.
Deep water is less dangerous than shallow water.
As you decrease your speed, the roadway becomes more slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: As you drive faster, your tires become less effective.
questions.explanation: On a wet road, the faster you drive, the less your tires can wipe away the water. If you go too fast, your tires lose grip and you may hydroplane, which means your car slides on water.

questions.question: If a police officer pulls you over, you should immediately exit your vehicle and quickly walk toward the officer's car.
questions.explanation: Stay in your vehicle with both hands visible on the steering wheel when stopped by police.

questions.question: What should you do if your accelerator gets stuck while driving?

options.text: Reach down and try to pull it up.
Shift to neutral and press the brake firmly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shift to neutral and press the brake firmly.
questions.explanation: If your accelerator sticks, keep your eyes on the road. Shift the vehicle into neutral and press the brake pedal steadily. Pull over when safe and turn off the engine.
